content.user_title: Plan Projects with Clear Tasks and Milestones
content.value_statement: Complex projects are hard to scope, sequence, and estimate. This skill turns a goal into milestones, task tables, dependencies, risks, and checkpoints.
actual_capabilities: Create work breakdown structures with phases, tasks, owners, and done criteria.
Define milestones with target dates, owners, and success criteria.
Estimate work using three-point estimation, t-shirt sizes, and task sizing rules.
Map dependencies, parallel work, critical path items, and bottlenecks.
Identify project risks with impact, probability, and mitigation actions.
Plan role allocation, weekly checkpoints, and success metrics.
limitations: Does not create tickets or update project management tools automatically.
Estimates depend on the scope, team, constraints, and assumptions provided by the user.
Does not replace stakeholder approval or committed resource allocation.
Provides planning structure, not live progress tracking.

use_cases.title: Plan a Product Launch
use_cases.description: Turn a launch goal into phases, milestones, owner assignments, dependencies, and launch risks.

use_cases.title: Estimate an Engineering Roadmap
use_cases.description: Break a technical roadmap into sequenced tasks, effort ranges, critical path work, and delivery checkpoints.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Client Delivery Plan
use_cases.description: Create a clear project plan with deliverables, review dates, resource needs, and mitigation actions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use project-planner to plan [project]. Include the goal, milestones, phases, task owners, dependencies, and top risks. My deadline is [date] and team is [roles].

prompt_templates.title: Estimate a Timeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use project-planner to estimate [project] with best, likely, and worst case timelines. Break tasks into 2 to 8 hour units and add a buffer.

prompt_templates.title: Map Dependencies
prompt_templates.prompt: Use project-planner to build a dependency map for [project]. Identify parallel work, blockers, critical path tasks, and review checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Review an Existing Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use project-planner to review this plan: [paste plan]. Find oversized tasks, missing dependencies, risk gaps, and milestone changes needed for delivery.

output_examples.input: Plan a six-week website redesign with one designer and two developers.
output_examples.output: A phased plan with discovery, design, development, QA, launch milestones, task owners, dependencies, risks, and weekly checkpoints.

output_examples.input: Estimate a mobile beta launch for a small product team.
output_examples.output: A timeline with task sizes, best and worst case estimates, buffer time, critical path items, and release readiness criteria.

output_examples.input: Review this project plan before kickoff.
output_examples.output: A planning review that highlights oversized tasks, unclear ownership, missing dependencies, high-risk assumptions, and recommended milestone changes.

best_practices: Provide the deadline, team roles, constraints, and known deliverables before asking for a plan.
Ask for task owners, done criteria, dependencies, and risk mitigations in the same request.
Review estimates with the delivery team before treating the plan as a commitment.
anti_patterns: Requesting a plan without scope, timeline, team size, or success criteria.
Treating the first estimate as final without review, buffer, or stakeholder alignment.
Keeping tasks larger than two days when they need daily tracking and clear ownership.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces structured project plans with milestones, phases, tasks, owners, dependencies, risks, resources, and success metrics.

faq.question: Can it estimate project timelines?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports three-point estimation, t-shirt sizing, buffers, and task sizing from 2 to 8 hours.

faq.question: Does it manage tasks in external tools?
faq.answer: No. It creates planning content but does not create tickets, update boards, or connect to project management systems.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the project goal, deadline, team roles, constraints, deliverables, and known dependencies.

faq.question: Can it help identify risks?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes risk tables with impact, probability, and mitigation suggestions.

faq.question: Is it useful for non-software projects?
faq.answer: Yes. The planning process works for product launches, operations work, client projects, and internal initiatives.
